macros.name: DTMifdate
macros.doc: This is just a convenient interface to \pgfcalendarifdate for a saved date (identified by 〈name〉).

macros.name: DTMsaveaszulutime
macros.doc: This converts the given datetime instance into UTC+00:00 and saves the result.

macros.name: DTMsaveddatediff
macros.doc: Computes the difference (in days) between two saved dates and stores the result in the given count register.

macros.name: DTMsavejulianday
macros.doc: This uses \pgfcalendarjuliantodate to obtain the year, month and day from the given Julian day number and uses \pgfcalendarjuliantoweekday to obtain the day of week and then saves it.

macros.name: DTMtozulu
macros.doc: Converts the datetime data referenced by the first argument into Zulu time and saves it to data referenced by the second argument.

macros.name: DTMweekdayname
macros.doc: This attempts to use \DTM〈lang 〉weekdayname if it exists, where 〈lang〉 is either \languagename or obtained from the dialect-to-language mapping provided by tracklang.
